# GME Foods

> GME Foods is a brand of G.M. Exim Private Limited, headquartered in Patna, Bihar, India. It makes and markets ready-to-eat snacks — namkeen, chips and extruded snacks — manufactured at its unit in Hajipur, Vaishali, Bihar, blending traditional Indian flavours with modern food-processing standards.

GME Foods products include Bhujia, Paneer Bhujia, Diet Chiwda, Moong Dal, mixtures, Chatori, Badaam Pakoda, Mumbai Bhel, chips and extruded snacks such as Tuk Tuk, Fingers and Curly Masala Puff, sold in ₹5 and ₹10 packs as well as 200g and 400g packs. Products are distributed across Bihar, Jharkhand, Eastern Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and the North Eastern States.
